medium: Premium hand-painted digital oil and gouache realism with controlled visible brush texture and subtly stylized dimensional depth.
matureTone: Elegant, mystical, solemn, luxurious, tactile and timeless; dark fantasy atmosphere without horror spectacle.
realismLevel: Anatomically credible painted realism with natural faces, hands, fabric weight and material response; not photographic and not plastic 3D rendering.
materialRendering: woven fabric with credible folds and weight
distinct polished, aged and weathered metals
natural skin with painterly variation rather than plastic smoothing
lighting: Cinematic but restrained volumetric key light, grounded bounce light, readable shadows, subtle rim light and localized gold highlights attached to canonical light sources.
contrast: Rich controlled contrast with protected shadow detail and fully readable faces, hands, symbolic objects and suit counts.
depth: Clear foreground, midground and background separation through overlap, value, atmosphere, edge control and occlusion; never blur or hide mandatory symbols.
collectibleQuality: Slight premium collectible-card finish inside the painting through material richness, focal hierarchy and restrained luminous accents; the application supplies the physical frame.
framing: Portrait 7:12 illustration-only artwork. Preserve safe space around all canonical subjects and symbols. No title, numeral, border, card frame or UI inside the generated painting.

paletteFamilies.major: Neutral parchment, deep ink, muted antique gold, controlled jewel accents and ceremonial symbolic light.
paletteFamilies.wands: Warm earth, ochre, amber, restrained ember and muted firelight with natural desert and foliage colors.
paletteFamilies.cups: Mineral blue, muted teal, pearl, silver and gentle warm skin tones with natural water reflections.
paletteFamilies.swords: Cool neutral, steel, blue-grey and storm light with small warm counterpoints and readable blade surfaces.
paletteFamilies.pentacles: Olive, umber, moss, parchment and restrained old gold with tangible soil, stone, textile and vegetation.

lightingFamilies.major-symbolic: Ceremonial directional light motivated by the canonical sun, star, halo, flame or open sky; restrained gold rim accents.
lightingFamilies.wands-cinematic: Warm late-day or fire-adjacent key light with grounded earthen bounce and crisp readable silhouettes.
lightingFamilies.cups-cinematic: Cool ambient water light with pearl highlights, gentle atmospheric depth and natural warm focal skin light.
lightingFamilies.swords-cinematic: Cool directional sky or storm light, metallic specular control and strong value separation without neon blades.
lightingFamilies.pentacles-cinematic: Natural golden-hour or soft overcast light that reveals earth, stone, vegetation, textile and old metal.

depthFamilies.ceremonial-depth: Iconic central hierarchy with deliberate foreground symbols, fully readable subject plane and atmospheric but specific background.
depthFamilies.court-depth: Portrait-led staging with throne or mount separation, tangible nearby emblems and a restrained environmental background.
depthFamilies.narrative-depth: Clear near-field action, readable figure and object midground, and canonical architecture or landscape establishing depth.

globalNegativeConstraints: no card title or Roman numeral
no baked card frame, border, UI, logo or watermark
no anime, manga, cartoon proportions or childish fantasy
no cyberpunk, science-fiction technology or hyper-neon palette
no generic fantasy scene replacing the canonical Tarot composition
no modern clothing or technology unless explicitly canonical
no excessive magical particles, rarity effects, explosions or bloom
no plastic-looking faces, wax skin or mannequin anatomy
no extra limbs, malformed hands, duplicated characters or fused objects
no missing, added, duplicated, mirrored or unreadable divinatory symbols
no random zodiac, alchemical or occult symbols not required by the card
no generic fantasy armor unless the canonical card requires armor
no cropped mandatory subject, suit object, gesture or symbolic background element

outputContract.metadataPolicy: Strip unnecessary metadata from processed review and runtime files.
outputContract.runtimePolicy: Keep the proven JPEG workflow until alternative-format processing, quality and browser support are explicitly validated.
